text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature had previously been eager to 
run in the Arima Kinen with the goal of 
defeating Tokai Teio, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature was surprised to learn that 
Matikanetannhauser had also decided to 
enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Either way, let's both give it our all! 
With that promise exchanged, the curtains 
rose on the Arima Kinen!
